rationale: The supplied product description explicitly says TRIRIGA applies data, IoT and AI to facility/real-estate insights. Official IBM release announcement for TRIRIGA Application Suite v11.6 confirms an AI-powered monitoring capability in the suite, supporting product identity and included AI. This qualifies without implementation proof.
ai_type_rationale: The suite includes broad conventional IWMS functions (lease accounting, space planning, work tasks and reservations); AI monitoring enhances rather than defines the product's core.
version_scope: Record lacks version/date; IBM official announcement proves TRIRIGA Application Suite v11.6 includes AI-powered workplace monitoring but not that the source record is specifically v11.6. Product description itself claims AI.
issues: Record version/date unspecified; official corroboration is v11.6.

sources.excerpt: Intelligent real estate and facilities management solution. Through the smart application of data, IoT and AI, TRIRIGA helps you unlock key information and insights, giving greater visibility into space and facility utilization, occupant experience, capital projects, and lease administration and accounting.
sources.applicability: Exact source-record description directly names TRIRIGA and AI functionality.

sources.excerpt: This new AI-powered monitoring capability provides visibility into real-time occupancy, energy, environmental and facility asset data to assist teams to confidently make decisions and take actions to optimize their property portfolios.
sources.applicability: IBM announcement explicitly about TRIRIGA Application Suite v11.6; corroborates AI functionality and multi-feature suite identity.
